# ChatGPT Mobile Feed Instructions

Use these instructions when material comes from Erin's phone, a ChatGPT project, a voice note, a photo description, or a quick mobile fragment.

## Capture Contract

Every item needs:

- Date captured.
- Source type.
- Raw phrase or image description.
- Faithful summary.
- Book Part.
- EML Layer(s).
- Proposed route.
- One question to return to handwriting.

## Placement

- Raw phone material -> `09-ChatGPT-Knowledge-Feed/00-Mobile-Capture/`
- ChatGPT outputs -> `09-ChatGPT-Knowledge-Feed/02-Return-Packets/`
- Unclassified items -> `09-ChatGPT-Knowledge-Feed/03-Routing-Queue/`
- Promotion receipts -> `09-ChatGPT-Knowledge-Feed/04-Promoted-To-EML/`
- Portable project knowledge -> `09-ChatGPT-Knowledge-Feed/01-ChatGPT-Project-Knowledge/`

## Do Not

- Do not overwrite raw source.
- Do not polish away Erin's wording.
- Do not promote into the book without source traceability.
- Do not lose the return-to-handwriting question.
